cr: Test-all vision — cut nothing; in-app plan/suite; one orb home + HUD widgets

epics.intro: First usable daily path: local plan/suite model, connect-once health, draft from one Jira story, edit, run one case with evidence on the orb home. Nothing existing is removed.

epics.summary: Test-all B — Failures developers can use
epics.intro: Evidence bundles, failure class, defect preview, pause-on-fail, rerun failed, known issues, notes — raw red stays visible.

epics.summary: Test-all C — Plan the whole project
epics.intro: Project-wide draft, coverage, drift, matrix, tags, import, search, history, Gradio parity for the same plan.

epics.summary: Test-all D — Run policy and the lab
epics.intro: Sequential default, parallel cap, flake/quarantine, named environments, credential status, timeouts, local notify, durations.
Document privacy, local side-effect audit, redact exports, backup/restore, offline last plan.

epics.summary: Test-all F — Role widget packs on orb home
epics.intro: ONE home for everyone (orb+chat). Role needs are HUD widgets from the Screen drawer that deep-link into App areas. No separate Tester/Manager homes.
Desktop cases, API/messaging, mocks, fixtures, visual, a11y, perf, sandbox-as-env, other frameworks, voice (KAN-81), installer, scheduled run. Stubs stay until deepened.
Design-only: manual session capture, pipelines section, multi-PC share without cloud. Do not Build-pick-up until a later council writes real AC.

stories.summary: Local plan, suite, case, and run model
stories.why: Runs need a home inside the app before any new screen is useful.
ac: A plan contains a suite of cases and runs, stored under the active security level.
OFFICIAL and SECRET plans are not listed together.
Creating these records does not remove or rewrite existing settings, reports, or Playwright files.
Existing plugin tests still pass.

stories.why: The app should say whether Jira, Ollama, and the target are reachable before a run.
ac: Desktop checklist saves existing keys (Jira URL, project, target URL, optional exe, messaging endpoint, level).
Health reports up/down for Jira, Ollama, and target URL without printing secrets.
Gradio can still edit the same keys.
Level switch still requires confirm.

stories.why: This PC can run one small model; the tester needs to see which one the agent will use.
ac: Settings list models local Ollama reports and save one as the agent model.
Running chat uses that model.
Switching model does not start a second model beside it.
If the chosen model is missing, UI says so and does not pretend success.

stories.summary: Draft a plan from one story and an optional document
stories.why: The plan should be reviewable in the app, traced to the story and the doc.
ac: An issue key produces a plan with summary, AC text, and drafted cases.
Each case stores the Jira key and, if used, the document name.
An upload adds draft cases only.
Nothing is written to Jira.
The person can see why a case was drafted (source line or AC bullet).

stories.summary: Edit the plan before any run
stories.why: A draft is not a run; testers correct, reorder, and disable cases first.
ac: Person can rename, reorder, disable, and add a note on a case.
Disabled cases are skipped by later runs.
Edits stay local.
Closing and reopening shows the same plan.

stories.summary: Empty state and starter template on orb home
stories.why: A new lab should show the next action on the orb home, not a blank shell.
ac: With no plan, orb home + checklist offers: check connection, draft from story key, or start a template.
Template creates normal cases the person can edit.
No second welcome canvas.
Existing App areas still open.

stories.summary: Run a single case and show evidence
stories.why: One headed run with result on that case is the alpha proof.
ac: Case runs Playwright headed against connected target URL.
Pass/fail, duration, and failure screenshot show on that case.
Tool or browser failure is not shown as a pass.
Other cases and disabled cases do not run.

stories.summary: Degraded mode when Jira, Ollama, or target is down
stories.why: The lab should stay readable when a dependency is down.
ac: If Ollama is down, draft/chat say unavailable and last plans still open.
If Jira is down, saved plans open; new Jira reads fail clearly.
If target is down, run fails as environment, not as a passed case.
No new secrets stored on these failures.

stories.why: Even a single story needs a line from case to Jira key and document.
ac: Case view shows Jira key, AC bullet or doc reference, and last run result.
A case with no source is marked manual-draft.
Does not require the full matrix in Epic C.

stories.summary: Evidence bundle on a failed case
stories.why: A screenshot alone is not enough to fix a UI defect.
ac: Failed browser case can attach screenshot, Playwright trace, and console messages.
Case page links each file under the run id.
Secrets are not written into the bundle on purpose.

stories.summary: Failure class before anyone files a bug
stories.why: Product bugs, bad tests, and environments should not share one queue.
ac: Tester sets class: product bug, test defect, environment, or known issue.
Class stored on the run.
Create-bug only for product bug via confirm path.
Other classes do not open Jira create.
oos: Silent auto-class by model without display.

stories.why: Bug text should be filled from the case before confirm.
ac: Preview shows symptom, expected, actual, environment, replication, evidence paths.
Confirm still required.
Cancel writes nothing.
Audit line has no tokens.

stories.why: Power users need to see the page at the broken step.
ac: Run option pauses when a step fails and leaves headed browser open until continue or stop.
Stop records a failed run.
Pause off by default.

stories.why: After a fix, the red cases are the ones that matter.
ac: From a finished run, rerun only failed cases sequentially.
New run id linked to same suite.
Disabled and quarantined cases skipped with reason shown.

stories.why: A known failure must be visible and must not look like a new regression.
ac: Case or failure can link a known-issue note and optional Jira key.
Run stays red underneath and labelled known.
Reports can include/exclude known issues.
Nothing auto-transitioned in Jira.

stories.summary: Notes on a case and on a run
stories.why: Exploratory comments need a home before full session recording.
ac: Local note on a case and on a run.
Notes appear in export when evidence section is on.
Notes are level-scoped with the plan.

stories.why: Gradio stays a way to use the app on the same plans.
ac: Gradio lists plans for active level and can start same single-case run.
Desktop results show in Gradio after refresh.
No Gradio panel removed.

stories.summary: Report sections and heal review for a run
stories.why: Export and locator heals should belong to the run that produced them.
ac: Section picker can export a chosen run.
Locator heal from that run shows in Heal review with approve/reject unchanged.
No auto-commit of healed steps.
Current report and heal screens still open.

stories.why: Agent should read a Jira project and draft a plan the person reviews.
ac: Reads use configured project and 429 backoff.
Visible batch size caps issues drafted in one action.
Person reviews before any run.
No Jira writes in this story.
One chosen case can run via A7 path.

stories.why: Untested stories are the point of reading the whole project.
ac: After project draft, stories with no case are listed.
Stories whose cases are all disabled listed separately.
Filterable.
Does not auto-create cases.

stories.why: A plan drafted last week may not match the story today.
ac: On demand, re-read linked issue and mark plan stale if summary/AC differs.
Old and new text shown.
Tester chooses keep or refresh drafts.
Refresh does not delete stored runs.

stories.why: Management needs Jira key, cases, latest run, and bugs in one grid.
ac: View lists story key, case count, last result, linked bug keys, known-issue flag.
Opening a row opens the case.
Export can include this grid.
Keys not loaded show as not loaded, not passed.

stories.why: Daily runs are a chosen slice of the suite.
ac: Case has priority and tags including smoke and regression.
Run all cases with a chosen tag sequentially.
Run stores run id and tag used.
Untagged omitted and listed as not selected.

stories.summary: Import a Playwright project into the suite
stories.why: Existing suites are an input; in-app suite stays the place you run from.
ac: Imported project appears as cases.
Today npx run still works from Suites area.
Imported case can be run one at a time from suite.
Import does not delete external project files.
oos: Replacing external repo as only source of truth.

stories.why: A project-sized suite is unusable without search.
ac: Search matches plan name, case name, Jira key, tag, failure class.
Results stay inside active security level.
Opening a hit shows the case.

stories.summary: Suite history and compare two runs
stories.why: What got worse since the last run is a release question.
ac: Suite lists past runs with time, duration, pass, fail, tag.
Compare shows cases that changed result.
Known issues labelled.
History local to the level.

stories.summary: Archive a case without deleting history
stories.why: Obsolete stories should leave the active suite and keep runs.
ac: Archive hides case from new runs and default lists.
Filter shows archived cases and old runs.
Archive does not delete evidence.
Unarchive returns case to suite.

stories.summary: Sequential default and a parallel cap
stories.why: Parallel browsers will stall this PC if the cap is implicit.
ac: Suite runs sequential unless tester sets parallel count.
Cap small and visible (default 1, max 2 this stage).
Run record stores count used.
Refuse number above cap.

stories.why: A flipping case should be marked, not silently ignored.
ac: Suite shows how often a case failed in last N runs.
Quarantine requires reason and expiry.
Quarantined skipped and listed on run.
After expiry return to selectable set.
Raw last failure remains visible.

stories.why: Local, test, and staging should not be one unmarked URL.
ac: Connection can store more than one named target under active level.
Run records environment name used.
Credentials stay in level store, not copied into plan.
Switching environment does not switch security level.

stories.why: Testers need to know a token is present, not what it is.
ac: Connection shows set/missing for Jira email, token, target secret — never the value.
Test-connection uses stored secret and reports success or human-readable auth error.
Clear-secret requires confirm; audit text has no old value.
oos: Echoing tokens in UI or logs.

stories.why: Hangs should be an explicit budget.
ac: Case shows step timeout; tester can change before run.
Timeout failure message says timeout.
Default matches current runner.

stories.summary: Local notification when a run finishes
stories.why: A long suite should not require staring at the window.
ac: When run completes, local notice states pass and fail counts.
No email, no cloud push.
Notice has no secrets or page text.
Can turn notices off.

stories.summary: Duration on the run and the case
stories.why: A suite that got much slower is a signal.
ac: Each case and run store duration.
History compare can show duration change.
Local only; no upload.

stories.why: Specs often contain customer data.
ac: Upload records file name, time, level, consent.
Privacy inventory includes uploaded docs.
Delete-local-data can remove them with confirm.
Exports omit document bodies unless documents section on.

stories.summary: Audit log for local side effects
stories.why: Plan edits, deletes, quarantines, wipes should be audited like Jira writes.
ac: Confirm-gated or destructive local actions append time, action, plan/case id, level, session.
No tokens or document body.
Openable from Security.
Jira write audit remains.

stories.summary: Redact secrets in evidence and exports
stories.why: Traces must not become a second copy of the token.
ac: Export and evidence index pass redaction for known secret patterns and stored token values.
Redaction hit counted in export summary.
Warn if screenshot cannot be redacted automatically.
oos: Guaranteeing OCR redaction of all pixels.

stories.summary: Backup and restore of this lab
stories.why: One disk is a single point of failure.
ac: Backup copies plans, runs, evidence index, and optional settings; secrets off by default.
Restore requires confirm and refuses to mix OFFICIAL and SECRET folders.
Restore reports what it replaced.

stories.summary: Read last plan while Jira is down
stories.why: Offline reading of a saved project plan.
ac: With Jira unavailable, search and matrix open on last stored keys and results.
Network actions disabled and explained.
Stored results labelled with fetch time.

stories.summary: Tester HUD widget pack on orb home
stories.why: One home for all; tester needs health, last run, fails, quarantine as widgets.
ac: Optional home widgets: connection health, last run, failed cases, quarantined cases.
Each row opens Plan/Suite on that case.
Screen drawer toggles them.
Chat and orb stay put.
Home-only; hidden while App area open.

stories.summary: Manager HUD widget pack on orb home
stories.why: Champion needs pass rate and gaps without a second home.
ac: Optional widgets: pass rate, known-issue count, stories with no cases, bugs from plan.
Figures open Reports or Plan/Suite.
Known issues not shown as passes.

stories.summary: Release HUD widget pack on orb home
stories.why: Go/no-go summary widgets linking to readiness in Reports.
ac: Optional widgets: environment name, last run, uncovered stories, open product bugs.
Links to readiness detail inside Reports.
Ticks stay on Reports surface, not a new home.

stories.summary: Coverage HUD widget pack on orb home
stories.why: AC coverage at a glance on the shared home.
ac: Optional widget for open story: AC lines covered/partial/missing.
Choosing a line opens Plan/Suite on linked case.
Widget does not edit Jira.

stories.summary: Keyboard on orb home and inside areas
stories.why: Power user shortcuts without hunting buttons.
ac: Documented shortcuts: run selected case, next failure, Back to orb.
Do not confirm Jira write or approve heal.

stories.why: Someone without the app should still read the run.
ac: Export writes folder: report, matrix, evidence per sections.
Opening report does not require this app.
Secrets redacted per E3.
Pack labelled with level and time.
Optional home widget can show last export time.

stories.why: First-hour checklist on orb home that can be hidden when done.
ac: Screen-drawer widget: connection, first plan, first run.
Hide when done; reopen from drawer.
Does not block chat or other areas.
oos: Forced wizard that blocks the app.

stories.summary: Desktop cases on the same suite
stories.why: Desktop .exe testing stays and should appear as cases beside browser cases.
ac: Case typed desktop runs with current desktop runner against connected exe.
Results on same run model.
Desktop area smoke still works.
Browser cases unchanged.

stories.why: Messaging endpoint setting should be assertable.
ac: Case can call saved messaging/API endpoint and store status + redacted body summary.
Failures class like other cases.
Secrets in body redacted in log.

stories.why: Stable answers when the real queue is down.
ac: Case can point at local mock fixture.
Run record says mock.
Live-endpoint cases unchanged.
Mocks off unless case selects one.

stories.why: Cases that assume a user or row need a named fixture.
ac: Fixture is local named file/steps, level-scoped.
Case can name a fixture; run stores name.
Missing fixture fails as environment.

stories.why: Layout regressions are normal browser testing.
ac: Case can store baseline and compare later.
Mismatch fails with both images linked.
Update-baseline is explicit.
Off unless case opts in.
One browser at a time.

stories.why: Teams need an a11y pass beside functional cases.
ac: Optional check on browser case attaches violations to run.
Does not replace functional result.
Disabled unless case opts in.
oos: Blocking all runs on a11y by default.

stories.why: Correct but too slow still fails a release.
ac: Case can store numeric budget; over budget fails that case.
Cases without budget unchanged.
Local collection only.

stories.summary: Sandbox chosen as the run environment
stories.why: Multi-sandbox records should be selectable on a run.
ac: If sandbox plugin enabled, run can name one existing sandbox.
Run record stores name.
Default remains normal browser profile.
Sandboxes screen still manages records.
Parallel capped by D1.

stories.why: Selenium/Cypress stay in product; real runners later; stub until then.
ac: When runner exists, case can select it; results use same run model.
Until then, Selenium/Cypress return not-implemented and do not mark passed.
Playwright remains default.

stories.summary: Voice as another way to ask (links KAN-81)
stories.why: KAN-81 stays; voice drives the same agent and plans.
ac: With microphone, voice request drafts/runs only through same confirm/review as text.
Without mic, stays deferred.
Text input remains.
Relates to existing KAN-81/KAN-82.

stories.summary: Installer for a second Windows PC
stories.why: Download the app is the thesis; packaging after alpha used.
ac: Second PC can install and open desktop app, enter local connections, draft a plan.
No shared cloud account.
Secrets not inside installer.
Maps to SALES-1; not a company-rollout claim alone.

stories.why: Morning smoke once sequential runs are trustworthy.
ac: Schedule one tagged run on this PC.
Uses sequential cap and saved connection.
Missed schedule (PC off) reported as not run, not pass.
Off until tester creates one.

stories.why: Auto-recorded exploratory sessions are part of the end state.
ac: Produces short design: charter start, what is recorded, how bug is proposed, confirm, OFFICIAL/SECRET separation.
Does not ship a recorder.

stories.why: CI is a separate section, not the primary authoring place.
ac: Produces short design: what pipeline record shows, what it will not do, secrets stay local.
Does not ship CI integration.

stories.summary: Plan shared use without a cloud (design only)
stories.why: Two testers on two PCs need a story beyond export pack.
ac: Lists local/on-prem options (export pack, backup copy, future shared folder) and security limits.
Does not pick or ship a network service.
